name: @wolffm/task-ui-components
description: Reusable UI components with Bento grid and metallic gradient support

scripts.build: vite build && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && node ../scripts/fix-imports.cjs dist && pnpm run copy-css
scripts.copy-css: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/task-ui-components.css', 'dist/styles.css'); fs.copyFileSync('src/theme-picker.css', 'dist/theme-picker.css'); fs.copyFileSync('src/app-header.css', 'dist/app-header.css'); fs.copyFileSync('src/toaster.css', 'dist/toaster.css'); fs.copyFileSync('src/context-menu.css', 'dist/context-menu.css'); fs.copyFileSync('src/bento.css', 'dist/bento.css'); fs.copyFileSync('src/modal.css', 'dist/modal.css')"
scripts._comment: copy-css requires source CSS files: theme-picker.css, app-header.css, toaster.css, context-menu.css, bento.css, modal.css (validated in CI)

author: wolffm
